associations.rationale: This only declares the opaque index type LoopIdx and does not display the claimed basis vectors or their loop degrees.
The type counts three opaque indices in each positive even degree, but does not itself identify the indexed elements as basis vectors of g_4.
The type counts five opaque indices in each odd degree, but does not itself identify the indexed elements as basis vectors of g_4.
The type counts one opaque index in degree zero, but does not display that its basis element is y.
The type gives a characteristic-zero basis of g_4 indexed by opaque LoopIdx, without displaying the vectors or the asserted degree distribution.
This is only an opaque family of elements indexed by LoopIdx and does not state that it is the claimed basis or expose its members and degrees.
